It also says re-enrolling invalidates the old QR code entirely; only the newly scanned one will generate valid codes afterward. So answer: you can just reset and re-enroll; old enrolment is invalidated automatically; you don't need to manually remove, just reset and scan new code. Provide steps. This is covered by policy. So we can post_reply.

Compose concise answer: go to Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication, choose Reset, then enable again scanning new QR code. Old enrolment will be invalidated automatically; you don't need to remove separately. Also can use recovery code if can't access settings. Provide that.
